purpose: Simple, readable teaching proxies; no manufacturing tolerances or photorealistic detail

categories.highlight: Cyan contact ring or local spotlight; never claim a segmentation contour from a proxy
categories.movement: Cyan direction plus a pale part proxy, loop along an explicitly authored path
categories.gesture: Future simplified hand with explicit contact/grip anchors; no realistic skin texture
categories.tool: Metal shaft, dark grip, amber action accent; origin is the working tip
categories.context: Future spatial text/timer cards with the application font and accessible contrast

materials: Flat colours, mild bevels, no textures or transparency-dependent fine detail
animation: Looped illustration only; positive-Y axis rotation is authored in asset coordinates; no required turn count or torque
placement: Functional origin and action axis must be explicit; unobserved roll/depth is not inferred from a generated mesh
visibility: Hide on missing/stale reference; photo review never advances the tutorial; no real-world occlusion without measured depth
